title: Clean crosshair
body:
# Thick & Clean Crosshair

A simple resource pack that makes the crosshair thicker, sharper, and easier to see — without adding unnecessary clutter.

## Features
- Thickened crosshair for better visibility  
- Clean, minimal design  
- Works seamlessly with most packs
- Actually centered (sorry, yes, the vanilla one is half a pixel too much to the left)

## In-game
![In-game](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/AEadvPFK/images/fbc7d0b6b41a934bd82be3a92160aa439e138cac.png)

## Recommended Mod
For extra customization, I highly recommend: [Crosshair Tweaks](https://modrinth.com/mod/crosshairtweaks)
Not mine but 🧑‍🍳💋

## Notes
- Looks best if you **do not have an inverted effect** *(use [Crosshair Tweaks](https://modrinth.com/mod/crosshairtweaks) for that)*
- Keeps the crosshair consistent across all backgrounds  
- Lightweight and performance-friendly (no extra assets)

---

### You will love it fast...
